title: 236. Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
inspired_by: Practice for LeetCode #236 (Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree). The statement and examples here are written for this lab; see LeetCode for the official version.
summary: Tree, DFS, Recursion. Write lowest_common_ancestor(root, p, q).
custom_input:
from solution import lowest_common_ancestor
from tree import build_tree, find

root = build_tree([3, 7, 1, 4, 9, None, 8, None, None, 2, 6])
print(lowest_common_ancestor(root, find(root, 4), find(root, 6)))
